name: Bauernhof Stöckl
beschreibung: The farm Bauernhof Stöckl is located within the municipality of Kufstein. This property is managed as an active agricultural farm with an adjoining traditional inn. In the dining room, authentic Tyrolean cuisine is served using quality ingredients from the region and the farm itself. Comfortable guest rooms are available for overnight stays. Its convenient proximity to Kufstein town center and the train station facilitates easy travel and sightseeing in the surrounding area. The farm is an excellent choice for both hikers and cultural travelers.
